notes.title: HELL ROAD VR RELEASE - Halloween mode, Weapons' skins, Level 7: Epitaph
notes.notes:
Hello Hell Riders, 

[h2]It's Official, Hell Road VR is finally available![/h2]

Hell Road VR's early access has been released about a year ago. Thanks to everyone that played and gave us feedback we've been able to create a fun, dynamic and thrilling experience in VR that we're proud of!

We wanted to do something to thank everyone that bought and played Hell Road VR during the early access, that's why we created a "Deluxe" version of Hell Road, adding 2 weapons' skins, one new gun and 3 soundtracks. This special edition will be given to [b]everyone[/b] that bought the game during its early access. 

In addition of this Deluxe edition, we reworked our Halloween game mode and improved it so you'll be able to slaughter Pumpkin-headed Zombies in a dark and anxious environment. If you never tried Hell Road VR's Halloween mode, you'll definitely love it! 


The last but not the least, the final level: [b]Epitaph[/b] is finally available. This final level takes place in a church, looking for Irene. We won't tell anything else here to let you discover what happened.


Thanks again for your support! We hope you'll love what we've been working on during these past months!

Take care on the road

--
TravoLab RePlay's Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389610/Hell_Road_VR/

notes.title: HELL ROAD VR'S RELEASE - Upcoming content and Halloween event
notes.notes:
Hello Hell Riders, 

[h2]It's Official, Hell Road VR will be releasing the 10th of October![/h2]

We've been working hard these past years to provide a thrilling experience for VR amateurs. Hell Road VR is all about riding a powerful motorbike while shooting at zombies in varied environments with loads of different weapons. 

We developed Hell Road VR side by side with you and we’re proud to have such a wonderful player base that helped us by giving feedback all along this year of early access. We’re also really proud to say that more than 50 content creators played Hell Road VR and absolutely loved it. Thank you everyone for your support!

Hell Road VR is scheduled to be available on the [b]10th of October[/b] as we think the Halloween holidays is a great time to release a zombie game in Virtual Reality. For this occasion, we developed special content related to Halloween that we hope will be exciting! 

We wanted to add something related to Halloween as it makes sense to kill thousands of zombies during this season. Our goal was to make players feel like the Ghost Rider while facing the swarms of zombies and we think we succeeded!

For this release, we'll add new content and of course, our level 7: Epitaph where our story ends. 
We'll come back to you shortly with the complete list of new additions and bugfixes. 

Thanks again for your support throughout this year and we hope you'll have fun as much as we did while we were developing Hell Road VR.

Don’t forget to follow us on Twitter if you want to know what we're  up to.

Take care on the road

--
TravoLab RePlay's Team

notes.title: HELL ROAD VR - UPDATE 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello Hell Road Riders,

This will be the last regular update before the final release of Hell Road VR! So, what's new?
Lots of things to be honest!


[h2]ABOUT THE UPDATE: [/h2]

First of all, we added the 6th level we've been working on for weeks, the "Cursed City" is now available!
We also added 37 game achievements that you'll be able to unlock, we had a great time creating these, we hope you guys will love it.

We added voice acting for levels 5 & 6 and we fixed sound bugs some of you were experiencing.

English and Russian subtitles are now available.

We worked on the weapon balancing and on the motorcycle upgrades, let us know what you think about these.

Finally, we replaced some car models with better looking ones and we added new trigger events in the first 3 levels of the game.


[h2]LIST OF CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The "Cursed City" is now available 
[*] We added 37 game achievements
[*] Voice acting for levels 5 & 6
[*] English and Russian subtitles
[*] Weapon balancing 
[*] Motorcycle upgrades
[*] Replaced some cars models
[*] New trigger events in level 1,2 & 3(Rocks and blocks)
[/list]


Thank you so much for playing Hell Road VR during the Early Access!

Don’t forget to follow us on Twitter if you want more info about Hell Road VR.

You can also write a review on Steam to tell us what you think.

Take care on the road

--
TravoLab RePlay's Team

notes.title: Hell Road VR : Update 1.4.5
notes.notes:
Hello Hell Riders,

Here’s another regular update that adds several things you guys suggested. 

The two first levels are quite difficult and some of you are struggling to get to the 4th and 5th levels. 
We added several difficulty levels before each level so you can discover Hell Road without dying too often and if you're quite confident in yourself you can try the hardest mode of difficulty if you're looking for some challenge. We also optimized and changed several things in the first level so it's now a bit easier to get through it.


[h2]Changes and improvements:[/h2]
- Added 4 difficulty levels
- Optimized and improved level 1
- Available upgrades are now highlighted in the menu.
- We fixed a bug on the weapon radial menu

Again, thank you so much for you support guys everyone!

Don’t forget to follow us on Twitter & Facebook if you want more info about Hell Road VR.

Hope to see you soon on the road!

notes.title: Hell Road VR : Update 1.4.1
notes.notes:
Hello Hell Riders,

Here’s a small Hell Road VR update. It’s primarily focused on arenas and analytics for us. 

Some of you guys told us it was super frustrating to have to restart from the beginning of the level if we were failing the wave shooting phase at the end of the level. Well, we heard you! We changed that.

We wanted to gather more info regarding what players do inside the game so we can change some aspects of the game. That’s why we added several trigger events, we wanted to gather info about what you guys are doing inside the game so we can improve it.

[h2]Changes and improvements:[/h2]
-	You can restart arenas without having to cross the level a second time.
-	Added trigger events to gather info and improve the game on a long term basis
-       Fixed crossbow laser sight position
-       Minor bugs fix

Again, thank you so much for you support guys! We’re getting there!

Don’t forget to follow us on Twitter & Facebook if you want more info about Hell Road VR. 

You can also write a review via steam to tell us what you think.

Take care on the road

notes.title: Hell Road VR - Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hi guys, this update is primarily focused on new content and minor bugfix. Unfortunately we haven’t been able to add level 5 in this update, we’re still doing some polishing on it and it will be ready for the next update! Sorry for the late, we want it to be perfect before we release it.

About new content, we added two new types of zombies and one new weapon. They’re only available in survival mode for the moment but they’ll be integrated in level 5 as soon as it’s ready. Speaking of survival mode, we added a new arena level.

We also worked on minor improvements and bugfix. We improved the time balance for story mode levels as well as fixed tutorial minor bugs and did some graphics improvements. 

[h3]New content :[/h3]
- The crossbow is now available in survival mode
- 2 new “swarm” zombies that are throwing infected projectiles
- New arena level in survival mode

[h3]Improvements and bugfix :[/h3]
- There was a bug which was displaying the tutorial at the beginning of each level, now it only shows it in level 1
- We added some minor graphic improvements
- We disabled the timer on arenas

Thanks very much for your feedback! Don’t forget to follow us on our social media to get news and updates about Hellroad.

notes.title: Hellroad VR : Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey guys, this update is a bugfix and improvement patch. We are still working on level 5 and 6, hopefully we’ll be able to release level 5 in the next few weeks. We’re also working on a new weapon; it’s nearly finished now, and we’ll probably add it in the next update with level 5. These past months we worked on controlling the bike by steering the handlebars with your hands. We encountered several issues that’s why it took so much time to arrive, but it’s finally here! 

So, for the major changes of 1.2, we added the possibility to control the motorcycle with the controller’s stick and by steering the handlebars. You guys asked for it and we have been working on it ever since. It was important for us to add these alternative controls to provide more accessibility and more immersion while driving the bike. 

We also spent time on the radial weapon selection menu. Several feedbacks showed that the weapon selection menu could be improved as it wasn’t easy to select the right weapon quickly while facing a difficult situation. With the radial weapon selection menu, we hope that it will smoother the gameplay and allow you to do epic moves. 

In addition to these changes, we worked on several minor aspects of the game such as calibration. You have now to press two keys to calibrate the game, which eliminates accidental presses while playing. You can now switch control types in the settings menu. The tutorial now contains training for every type of motorcycle handling. We improved zombies and dogs’ animations; it will now feel more realistic. 

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
-Some of you had bugs while upgrading your bike and/or weapons, we fixed the prices display so now you will be 100% sure of what you are buying and at what cost. 
-Some of you told us that level 1 timer was too short as it was starting in the beginning of the tutorial. --We decided to start the timer after the tutorial phase so you can take your time to handle the bike before riding straight to hundreds of zombies.
-We added a dust effect on falling stones, it feels now more realistic.
-No more weird sound when you misfire with the shotgun.  

[h2]Features & Enhancements:[/h2]
-Added motorcycle stick controls
-Motorcycle steering
-Radial weapon selection menu
-Changed calibration by pressing two keys, which eliminates accidental presses
-Added switching control types in the settings menu
-The updated tutorial contains training for all types of motorcycle handling
-Improved zombies and dogs’ animations

[h2]Fixes:[/h2] 
-Fixed bug on upgrade prices
-The level timer now starts after completing the tutorial
-Added the effect of dust from falling stones in the location
-Fixed shotgun misfire sound bug
